items.summary: Maintain a small, capacity-gated pipeline: complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net. The strongest candidate is complicated.work with a site-factory build score of 84 and an existing scaffold. Preserve planning only while delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots. The readiness package must define the site brief, reusable template, initial content seed, SEO metadata and crawl baseline, analytics and affiliate readiness without inventing telemetry, owner assignment, legal/compliance checklist, security review, measurement plan, and preview-only launch gate with rollback. No domain change, spend, credentials, deployment, publication, or launch is authorized before owner, legal, security, measurement, and rollback gates pass. Exactly one next step: after CTO releases one delivery slot, assign an owner to complete the complicated.work launch-readiness brief.

Reject new site-factory execution this cycle. Existing capacity, measurement windows, failed requests, and the canonical saveusfarms.com repair-or-close case remain unresolved. Keep the three scaffold candidates as bounded planning context only; do not create duplicate queue work or claim analytics, affiliate, revenue, SEO, compliance, security, or launch readiness that is not evidenced.
